title Reserva Salvaje - the savanna reserve: an adventurous A dorian ostinato with light toms inside the notes (low-high), a kalimba hook in 3+3+2, a horn that looks over the plain, then the same a fourth higher (D dorian) and a chromatic run back to the start
tempo 140
vol 235
meter 4/4
inst kal dec=5 sus=0.1 slow
inst thum v=255,210,170,140
inst horn att=4 vib=1 vdelay=10 vper=16 slow lvl=0.85
inst tl drum=d5 v=235,190,140 d=0,-40,-70
inst th drum=g5 v=215,160,110 d=0,-40,-70
inst rim drum=c7 v=160,70 d=0,-30
l16
# --- 1-2: the toms call (low low high, low high high ...)
!tl4 r8 !tl8 !th4 !th8 !tl8 |
!tl4 !th8 !th8 !tl4 [ !th16 ]4 |
# --- 3-4: the ostinato (A dorian: A, C, E, D): the plain at dawn
@thum o4 !tl:a8 a8 >!th:c8< a8 !tl:e8 a8 !th:d8 >c8< |
@thum o4 !tl:a8 a8 >!th:c8< a8 !tl:e8 a8 !th:g8 e8 |
# --- 5-8: the kalimba hook (3+3+2), question and answer, then up to the high A and home
@kal o5 !th:e4. e8 g4 a8 g8 |
@kal o5 !tl:e4. d8 c4 d8 e8 |
@kal o5 !th:a4. a8 >c4< b8 a8 |
@kal o5 g4. e8 d4 e8 !tl:a8 |
# --- 9-10: the horn looks over the plain
!tl4 @horn o5 e2. |
@horn o5 d2 e2 |
# --- 11-12: the ostinato a fourth higher (D dorian: D, F, A, G)
@thum o4 !tl:d8 d8 !th:f8 d8 !tl:a8 d8 !th:g8 f8 |
@thum o4 !tl:d8 d8 !th:f8 d8 !tl:a8 d8 >!th:c8< a8 |
# --- 13-14: the hook, answered higher
@kal o5 !th:a4. a8 >c4 d8 c8< |
@kal o5 !tl:a4. g8 f4 g8 a8 |
# --- 15-16: the chromatic run up (one 16th per step) and the toms roll back to the start
@kal o5 a16 a+16 b16 o6 c16 c+16 d16 d+16 e16 f16 f+16 g16 g+16 a16 a+16 b16 o7 c16 |
[ !th16 ]4 [ !tl16 ]4 !tl8 !th8 !tl8 !th8 |
